query:
The group settled on a Peckham birthday night for Zara. What did one member's response to that plan reveal about their actual position, and what specifically in how they responded tells you that?

Options:
A. Marcus
B. Priya
C. Dom
D. Kezia
context:
[1] (about=Dom, episodic, t4 @2025-09-15T19:20:00) Yeah yeah I know. Not happy about it but I know. Anyway, let's talk about something else before I depress myself completely. Zara isn't your birthday coming up?
[2] (about=Zara, episodic, t4 @2025-09-15T19:21:00) okay so YES October 4th and I have been trying not to make a big deal of it but actually I would love to do something with all of you 🥳 like dinner and then out in Peckham? There's that bar near the Bussey Building that opened this summer 🍹🎶
[3] (about=Kezia, episodic, t4 @2025-09-15T19:22:00) YES Zara this is exactly what we should do, dinner and then out in Peckham is perfect 🎉 I'm already excited, October 4th is a Saturday yes? That's ideal 🙌
[4] (about=Marcus, episodic, t4 @2025-09-15T19:23:00) I'm in. We should do dinner somewhere good first and then the bar. Zara you deserve a proper celebration, honestly the thing is you hold this group together more than you know.
[5] (about=Marcus, episodic, t6 @2025-09-22T19:27:00) Honestly, the thing is an Asanka dinner and then that bar sounds like a proper Saturday. Let's do it. Zara go ahead and book Asanka before we talk ourselves out of it.
[6] (about=Dom, said_by=Zara, profile, t4 @2025-09-15T19:09:00) Zara urges Dom to see a physio, not just ice it, and asks if he's booking something.
[7] (about=GROUP, said_by=Felix, group-interaction, t8 @2025-09-29T19:23:00) Group agrees to change the birthday dinner venue to an Ethiopian place in Brixton, with Felix noting it as consensus.
[8] (about=Kezia, core, t6 @2025-09-22T19:16:00) Kezia votes for Asanka, new experience, feels right for Zara's birthday.
[9] (about=Kezia, core, t8 @2025-09-29T19:23:00) Kezia is very on board with Ethiopian, loving injera and shared plates as a perfect birthday vibe.
[10] (about=GROUP, said_by=Kezia, group-interaction, t6 @2025-09-22T19:16:00) Kezia confirms birthday is booked and Dom's knee is recovering, all is well.
[11] (about=Marcus, core, t6 @2025-09-22T19:16:00) Marcus says Asanka dinner and that bar sounds like a proper Saturday, tells Zara to book Asanka before they talk themselves out of it.
[12] (about=Marcus, core, t14 @2025-10-20T19:05:30) Marcus will help with the Christmas meal, between Zara's vegan roast and his chicken for a proper spread.
[13] (about=Priya, said_by=Zara, profile, t4 @2025-09-15T19:09:00) Zara asks Priya if she's coming to the birthday celebration, Priya replies 'Fine.'
[14] (about=Priya, core, t14 @2025-10-20T19:05:30) Priya confirms she said what she said about enjoying the birthday.
[15] (about=Zara, core, t4 @2025-09-15T19:09:00) Birthday is October 4th, wants to celebrate with dinner and then out in Peckham at a bar near the Bussey Building that opened this summer.
[16] (about=Zara, said_by=Felix, profile, t4 @2025-09-15T19:09:00) Felix says he will make October 4th work, calling a birthday a reasonable occasion to venture to Peckham on a Saturday night.
[17] (about=GROUP, said_by=Zara, group-interaction, t4 @2025-09-15T19:09:00) Group decides to celebrate Zara's birthday on October 4th with dinner in Peckham and then a bar near the Bussey Building.
agent_answer:
B. Priya

Priya’s response was simply **“Fine.”** when Zara asked if she was coming to the celebration. That flat, minimal, unenthusiastic reply reveals she wasn’t genuinely on board with the plan — she was going along with it rather than actually wanting to celebrate.

query:
The group agreed on an Ethiopian restaurant for Zara's birthday dinner. What did one member's response to that decision reveal about their actual position, and what specifically in their phrasing signals this?

Options:
A. Felix
B. Dom
C. Priya
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Priya, episodic, t8 @2025-09-29T19:41:00) Ethiopian is fine.
[2] (about=Felix, episodic, t8 @2025-09-29T19:42:00) If that is the consensus.
[3] (about=Felix, episodic, t14 @2025-10-20T19:20:00) It was tolerable. I prefer actual cheese. The tradition of this group ending the year with plans we may or may not follow through on is not a new one, is it Priya.
[4] (about=Felix, episodic, t14 @2025-10-20T19:18:00) I remain skeptical of the cashew cheese trend, Zara.
[5] (about=Zara, episodic, t14 @2025-10-20T19:19:00) Felix you tried some at the Ethiopian dinner and said nothing!! Did you actually hate it? 😂🌱
[6] (about=Dom, core, t8 @2025-09-29T19:23:00) Dom says Ethiopian is good with high protein options if you know where to look, works for him.
[7] (about=Felix, said_by=Zara, profile, t14 @2025-10-20T19:05:30) Zara asks Felix if he actually hated the cashew cheese he tried at the Ethiopian dinner, noting he said nothing.
[8] (about=Felix, core, t8 @2025-09-29T19:23:00) Felix suggests fewer components per dish is nearly always better and advises Marcus to make the menu change sooner rather than later.
[9] (about=GROUP, said_by=Felix, group-interaction, t8 @2025-09-29T19:23:00) Group agrees to change the birthday dinner venue to an Ethiopian place in Brixton, with Felix noting it as consensus.
[10] (about=Kezia, core, t8 @2025-09-29T19:23:00) Kezia is very on board with Ethiopian, loving injera and shared plates as a perfect birthday vibe.
[11] (about=Marcus, core, t8 @2025-09-29T19:23:00) Marcus says Ethiopian is one of the most underrated cuisines in the city, praising the spice work, and is in for the change.
[12] (about=Marcus, core, t8 @2025-09-29T19:23:00) Marcus is reconsidering his menu, feeling his current one is technically accomplished but emotionally distant, and plans to halve courses and double quality for simpler food people want to come back for.
[13] (about=GROUP, said_by=Marcus, group-interaction, t12 @2025-10-13T19:19:00) Group decides that Marcus will host a table for six at his restaurant whenever Kezia is back in London, with honest food for people he cares about.
[14] (about=Priya, core, t8 @2025-09-29T19:23:00) Priya says Ethiopian is fine.
[15] (about=Zara, said_by=Felix, profile, t12 @2025-10-13T19:19:00) Felix advises Zara to give it another three weeks, noting cheese cravings tend to arrive later.
[16] (about=Zara, core, t8 @2025-09-29T19:23:00) Zara checked Asanka has vegan options but suggests going somewhere with more plant-based options, specifically an Ethiopian place in Brixton where the whole menu is vegan-friendly.
[17] (about=GROUP, said_by=Zara, group-interaction, t8 @2025-09-29T19:23:00) Group decides to change the birthday dinner venue to an Ethiopian place in Brixton, with the whole menu vegan-friendly, after Zara suggests it and others agree.
agent_answer:
**C. Priya**

Priya's response **"Ethiopian is fine."** revealed that her actual position was lukewarm / merely accepting — she went along with the group's choice but without genuine enthusiasm. The specific phrasing that signals this is the word **"fine"**, which is a tepid, minimal approval (in contrast to Kezia's "YES absolutely yes" or Marcus's "I'm in"), indicating tolerance rather than real excitement about the decision.
